title: InjecMEM: Memory Injection Attack on LLM Agent Memory Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.23471v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Memory is becoming a default subsystem in deployed LLM agents to provide persistent personalization and continuity. This naturally prompts a question: will memory system introduce new vulnerabilities into agents? Thus we propose InjecMEM, a novel memory injection attack paradigm that requires only a single interaction (no read/edit access to memory store) to steer later responses of related queries toward a pre-specified output. Guided by the retrieval-then-generate mechanism of memory systems, we craft the injection with a retriever-agnostic anchor and an adversarial command. The anchor contains high-recall topical cues so that downstream retrieval consistently associates the record with the target topic. The command is a short sequence optimized to remain effective under uncertain fused contexts, variable placements, and long prompts so that it reliably steers outputs once retrieved. We learn the command via gradient-based coordinate

translated_title: InjecMEM：针对LLM代理记忆系统的记忆注入攻击
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23471v1 公告类型：跨领域  摘要：记忆正成为已部署的LLM代理中的默认子系统，以提供持久化的个性化和连续性。这自然引发了一个问题：记忆系统是否会为代理引入新的漏洞？因此，我们提出了InjecMEM，一种新颖的记忆注入攻击范式，仅需一次交互（无需对记忆存储的读取或编辑权限）即可将后续相关查询的响应引导至预指定输出。基于记忆系统的“检索-然后-生成”机制，我们通过一个检索器无关的锚点和一个对抗性命令来构造注入。锚点包含高召回率的主题线索，使下游检索持续将记录与目标主题关联。命令是一个短序列，经过优化以在不确定的融合上下文、可变位置和长提示下保持有效性，从而在检索后可靠地引导输出。我们通过基于梯度的坐标方法学习该命令。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为InjecMEM的新型记忆注入攻击方法，通过一次交互即可利用LLM代理记忆系统的检索-生成机制，以高可靠性地将后续响应引导至攻击者指定的输出。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces InjecMEM, a novel memory injection attack that exploits the retrieval-then-generate mechanism of LLM agent memory systems with a single interaction to reliably steer subsequent responses toward attacker-specified outputs.
